cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

mechanism: A controls the etiquette of tea and goodbye to keep B present as finishing tea becomes a request for an attentive farewell.
confusable: D194 stays for an objective result; D218 returns to the first reason with a changed personal meaning.
comparison: Hospitality and rushed goodbye differ from returning a relationship-bearing key.
seedUse: Keep completed tea as B's reason to leave; make B offer practical help rather than a cue for A's emotional explanation.
